subject.title: [Feature]: Add Korean (ko) language support to Control UI and AI agent

question: Should OpenClaw enforce same-language agent replies and Korean-aware search defaults globally, or keep language behavior controlled by user/context/provider instructions?
rationale: The remaining work changes core prompt/search policy rather than repairing a defined broken contract, and the prior mixed-scope PR was closed with guidance to keep locale work separate from default agent prompt behavior.

options.title: Split policy from locale work
options.body: Keep the shipped UI locale as-is and require transcript proof plus maintainer-approved prompt/search policy before implementing the agent-language portion.

options.title: Add a narrow same-language rule
options.body: Approve a provider-neutral prompt/test change for language persistence while avoiding Korean-specific defaults unless separately justified.

options.title: Decline the agent-policy scope
options.body: Treat the shipped Control UI locale as the accepted scope and ask for a new focused issue if concrete agent-language evidence appears.

recommendation.title: Split policy from locale work
recommendation.body: Keep the shipped UI locale as-is and require transcript proof plus maintainer-approved prompt/search policy before implementing the agent-language portion.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the strongest current evidence trail for the UI i18n pipeline and already made the related scope decision on the closed mixed PR.
